description: This file declares functions and structures related to HTTP and HTTPS connection setup and management within the cURL project. It primarily defines interfaces for adding and inserting HTTP connection filters and setting up HTTPS connections.

methods.name: Curl_cf_http_connect_add
methods.description: Adds an HTTP connection filter to the cURL connection data, configured with parameters such as remote host info and protocol options.

methods.name: Curl_cf_http_connect_insert_after
methods.description: Inserts a new HTTP connection filter after a specified filter within the cURL filter chain, using connection and remote host information.

methods.name: Curl_cf_https_setup
methods.description: Configures the setup for HTTPS connections, including data, connection, remote host info, and socket index.
